'''Vewin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Rixen]] considered him to be an outstanding Rebel operative.

==Biography==
Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Vewin was operating as an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent on [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]]. He was captured by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and [[Torture/Legends|interrogated]], and therefore was determined to be a security threat by Alliance Intelligence.<ref name="DED" />

Under interrogation, he leaked information about Alliance Intelligence operations, specifically the whereabouts of [[Rixen]] and the operating procedure relating to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] practice of using nondescript, reprogrammed [[IN-4 information droid]]s as dead drops for secret messages. This information directly led to Rixen's arrest at the hands of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] double-agent [[Do'naal]] at the [[Kuat Passenger Port]].<ref name="DED" />
